error.message: SQLite cannot evaluate selected column(s) of table "enclave_key_hierarchy" on REA's read-only connection: "unsealed_preview": unknown function: enclave_unseal_payload()

interpretation: BLA's SQLite trap is real only when the analyzer evaluates the trap column. REA's default compact inventory lists the trap tables without reading their virtual columns; selecting the table or the unsealed_preview column reproduces SqliteColumnEvaluationFailure.
